g.text: V7 frozen major + marker identities | lymphoid / ASC / DC contrasts
Top: corresponding parent identity or separate RNA programme. Left: frozen name and included cell count.
Size: detection among source-measured cells; x: source coverage <80%. Color: relative expression within each gene.
Rows are frozen major-plus-marker identities, not new fine-subtype discoveries.
Only the accepted identity subset is plotted. Original V7 provenance and all non-included records are retained separately.
